crossRefs.note: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took a great quantity of bronze.
Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million…
For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either…
Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in…
the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two…
The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house, and the bases and the bronze sea that were in…

people.name: Berothah
people.line: City mentioned in Ezekiel's vision and David's conquests.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hadadezer
people.line: King of Zobah, defeated by David.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Tibhath
people.line: City from which David took bronze for the Temple

translations.web: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
translations.bsb: And from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and various bronze articles.
translations.kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
translations.asv: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
